as_told.title: SRI remote viewing tests and Ingo Swann

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a man named Hal Puthoff ran a psychic spying programme for the CIA, the US Central Intelligence Agency, between roughly the 1970s and 1990s. The programme used remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places with the mind alone. Michels says many of these remote viewers, such as a man named Ingo Swann, reported seeing beings in various places, including the far side of the Moon. A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, describes the same work differently, stressing that the tests at SRI, the research institute where they were done, showed statistical improvements, and praising Swann's work. If true, it would mean the government took psychic spying seriously and that its spies glimpsed beings off Earth.
